//: lib: ["ES2018"] is the floor this package actually needs, and it needs nothing else. The async family (AsyncGenerator, AsyncGeneratorFunction, AsyncIterable, AsyncIterableIterator, Symbol.asyncIterator) lands in ES2018; verified ES2017 fails on all of it (TS2318/TS2583/TS2749). DOM is deliberately absent -- `URL` (is.ts's isUrl) is the one identifier that would otherwise need it, resolved instead through types: ["node"] (Node's ambient URL) so the rest of the package doesn't inherit the full DOM surface for one type.
